scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:runtime && npm run build:css && npm run build:site
scripts.build:vite: npm run build:tools && npm run build:runtime && node scripts/css-build.mjs && vite build
scripts.check: npm run audit && npm run build:tools && npm run build:runtime && node scripts/css-build.mjs && node scripts/check-site.mjs && node scripts/check-generated.mjs
scripts.check:local: npm run typecheck && npm run build:tools && npm run build:runtime && node scripts/css-build.mjs && node scripts/check-site.mjs && node scripts/check-generated.mjs
scripts.check:css: npm run build:tools && node scripts/css-build.mjs && node scripts/css-contracts.mjs && node scripts/css-build.mjs --check && node scripts/check-generated.mjs
scripts.check:generated: npm run build:tools && npm run build:runtime && node scripts/css-build.mjs && node scripts/check-generated.mjs
scripts.check:json: npm run build:tools && npm run build:runtime && node scripts/json-contracts.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build:tools && npm run build:runtime && node scripts/css-build.mjs && node scripts/dev-orchestrator.mjs
scripts.dev:host: npm run build:tools && npm run build:runtime && node scripts/css-build.mjs && node scripts/dev-orchestrator.mjs --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.dev:open: npm run build:tools && npm run build:runtime && node scripts/css-build.mjs && node scripts/dev-orchestrator.mjs --open
scripts.test:engagement: npm run build:tools && npm run build:runtime && node --import ./scripts/tests/setup-dom-globals.mjs --import ./scripts/tests/register-public-imports.mjs --test scripts/tests/engagement-features.test.mjs
